+@[expose] public section

+universe u w

+
+/-- Orthogonality of the augmentation cone to locally complete objects.
+
+Source: Stacks Project, algebraization.tex, Tags 099B and 099F,
+lemma-derived-completion and proposition-derived-completion.
+(blueprint: lem-weil-pbc-extended-cech-cone-orthogonality).
+
+Proof: Work locally on a covering by finite generating lists. Cancel the identity
+ring-term pair in the cone of the Cech augmentation. The remaining complex has
+a finite filtration with graded pieces finite sums of shifts of localizations
+at nonempty products of generators. Every such product is an ideal section, so
+internal Hom from its localization to a locally complete L is zero. Exactness
+of contravariant derived internal Hom and finite induction on the filtration
+give zero Hom from the cone. Slice restriction commutes with internal Hom and
+mapping cones; cohomology-sheaf descent then gives the global vanishing. With
+an empty list the cone is contractible. The argument has no boundedness
+assumption on L and uses no exactness of infinite products.
+-/
+theorem ringedExtendedCech_cone_orthogonality
+    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
+    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
+    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
+      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O))]
+    [∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
+      ((sheafCompose (J.over U) (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj (O.over U)))]
+    (I : ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O))
+    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O))
+    [Mono ι] [I.IsFiniteType]
+    (K : ringedSiteComplex O) (ε : K ⟶ ringedSiteRingComplex O)
+    (hK : HasLocalExtendedCechDescription O I ι K ε)
+    (L : ringedSiteDerived O)
+    (hL : IsLocallyDerivedRingedIdealComplete O I ι L) :
+    CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero ((derivedInternalHom J O).obj
+      (Opposite.op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone ε)), L)) := by sorry
+
+end CategoryTheory
